autowhite_delay.description: Number of seconds after which a previously greylisted sender is automatically whitelisted.

dbfile.description: Path to the greylist database file.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for communication with MTA.

user.description: User account to run the milter process as.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections the milter will handle.

whitelist_networks.description: List of networks (CIDR or hostnames) to exempt from greylisting.

whitelist_senders.description: List of exact sender addresses or domains to whitelist.

greylist_exceptions.description: List of greylist exceptions (e.g., for servers with strict retry policies).

greylist_delay.description: Initial greylist delay (seconds) before accepting mail from unknown senders.

autowhite_life.description: Lifetime (seconds) for auto-whitelisted entries in the database.

use_dnsbl.description: Enable DNSBL checks to help identify likely spammers (requires DNSBL libraries at build time).
